$$

$$

$$

\text{distance} = 0.5 \cdot 78.83 \cdot (1.61)^2
$$

$$
(1.61)^2 = 2.5921
$$

$$
\text{distance} = 0.5 \cdot 78.83 \cdot 2.5921 \approx 101.665 \, \text{m}
$$

---

\boxed{11.77} \, \text{meters}
$$
